critical.issue: add_unsubscribe_footer is accepted by CreateCampaignRequest (default False) and UpdateCampaignRequest (default None) Pydantic models BUT never persisted. server.py:4043 Campaign(...) constructor call omits add_unsubscribe_footer, the Campaign model itself (server.py:1766) lacks the field, and update_campaign (server.py:4072) has no `if request.add_unsubscribe_footer is not None: update_data['add_unsubscribe_footer'] = ...` branch. Send loop reads campaign.get('add_unsubscribe_footer', False) at server.py:5675 which is permanently False -> the unsubscribe-footer toggle in Campaign.jsx is functionally dead. Test evidence: POST with add_unsubscribe_footer=True followed by GET shows the field absent from the campaign document; PUT with add_unsubscribe_footer=False followed by GET also shows it absent.

integration_issues.issue: Toggle is wired in the UI form (data-testid='add-unsubscribe-footer-toggle' present, default OFF) and the create payload includes add_unsubscribe_footer in formData, but because backend silently drops it (see backend critical), turning it ON in the UI has no effect on outgoing email — confirmed by direct API test (POST with True, GET shows missing).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Add `add_unsubscribe_footer: Optional[bool] = False` to the Campaign model (server.py:1766). In create_campaign (server.py:4043) pass add_unsubscribe_footer=request.add_unsubscribe_footer to Campaign(...). In update_campaign (server.py:4072) add `if request.add_unsubscribe_footer is not None: update_data['add_unsubscribe_footer'] = request.add_unsubscribe_footer`. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_31_features.py::TestCampaignAddUnsubscribeFooterPersistence to verify all three cases pass.
(Optional verification) Visit /lists with a user that has at least one list to visually verify list-contacts-badge-{id} renders with formatted counts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~6900 lines. The 3-place wiring required for a single new persisted field (model, create constructor, update branch) is exactly the kind of bug that gets shipped — splitting routers into modules per resource (campaigns/drip/admin/subscription) would have caught the missing constructor arg via type-checking on Campaign(...) signature.

create_campaign already drops several fields silently if they are not in the Campaign() signature (compare Campaign() call at 4043 against CreateCampaignRequest fields). Recommend changing Campaign() to accept **request.model_dump() with field_validators, or use `Campaign.model_validate({**request.model_dump(), 'user_id': user.user_id})`. Same pattern would have made add_unsubscribe_footer work automatically.

Send-loop guard `campaign.get('add_unsubscribe_footer', False)` at server.py:5675 quietly defaults to False on missing key — this masked the persistence bug. Consider asserting/logging at campaign-creation time that all CreateCampaignRequest fields landed in the Mongo doc (drift detector).

AdminLimitOverrideRequest endpoint at server.py:6377 has a duplicated `except HTTPException / except Exception` block (6443-6447 then again 6448-6450 in the next function header area — likely a copy-paste leak that does no harm but is dead code). Worth a cleanup pass.

Drip card markup wraps content in an anchor and a separate 'Open' button; clicking the card body does not navigate. Minor UX nit — either make the entire card a clickable region or remove the redundant 'Open' button.

rca of the issue: BUG: add_unsubscribe_footer never persisted. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/campaigns with body {name,subject,body,add_unsubscribe_footer:true}; (2) GET /api/campaigns/{id} -> response object lacks add_unsubscribe_footer key. Root cause: the Campaign Pydantic model (server.py line 1766) was never updated to include `add_unsubscribe_footer: Optional[bool] = False`; consequently the create_campaign handler's Campaign(...) call silently ignores the request value (Pydantic `extra=ignore` default), and update_campaign's hand-rolled update_data dict has no branch for it. Send-loop default `campaign.get('add_unsubscribe_footer', False)` then locks the feature OFF for every campaign in DB. Mitigation: 3-line fix described in action_items #1; preferred long-term mitigation: replace hand-rolled update_data branches with `update_data.update({k: v for k, v in request.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items() if k in ALLOWED_CAMPAIGN_UPDATE_FIELDS})` so future opt-in flags don't suffer the same fate.
